assessments.scoped_claim: The isolated 26-fixture Phase-1 parity acceptance matrix and checker reproduce their precommitted expected finding sets across all eight declared dimensions.
assessments.note: Direct, reproducible local synthetic evidence with exact checker/fixture digests and positive/adversarial coverage. It does not establish operational Chat-mode reliability or intervention effect sizes; the source explicitly limits completion to the isolated synthetic-fixture leaf.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not generalize fixture coverage to recurring-objective completion, generic worker reliability, or real connector/server execution.

assessments.scoped_claim: Within the 1,184-scenario-per-protocol finite grammar, generation+leaf-epoch fencing eliminates the modeled lease-only false terminalizations and duplicate authoritative integrations while retaining the modeled safe parallel admissions.
assessments.note: Strong matched synthetic mechanism comparison with exhaustive enumeration and a negative control separating stale-writer fencing from effect/merge independence. Generalization is limited because the canonical integrator is serialized and several crash/cancellation/multi-file races are deliberately outside the grammar.
assessments.scope_guard: Synthetic mechanism ratios are not real-world incidence estimates and do not prove connector/server correctness.

assessments.scoped_claim: The inspected Chat-connected GitHub surface supports several exact readback/CAS-style building blocks but lacks some stronger public GitHub capabilities, and the proposed crash/retry protocol identifies explicit fail-closed recovery rules under those observed capability boundaries.
assessments.note: Primary public API documentation and read-only connector capability observations are strong for capability boundaries. The composite branch-CAS, lease discipline, PR ambiguity recovery, and evidence-binding recipes are protocol inferences rather than executed end-to-end fault-injection results.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not treat public GitHub features absent from the connector as Chat-direct capability; do not treat the inferred protocol as an empirical replication.

assessments.scoped_claim: The deterministic Phase-1 architecture satisfies its stated finite model properties for reconstruction, conflict selection, direct-first traces, blocker transversals, pointer CAS, and generation-fenced handoff races.
assessments.note: Large finite property checks provide strong internal mechanism evidence and expose a concrete same-role stale-pointer case. They prove only the model; global cross-role exclusivity and connector/server implementation remain unexecuted dependencies.
assessments.scope_guard: No claim of global cross-role handoff safety, real storage atomicity, or arbitrary-state proof.

assessments.scoped_claim: For the tested SQLite-WAL controller plus idempotent/reconcilable SQLite provider model, durable authority ordering and reconcile-before-replay preserve the safe incumbent and avoid duplicate completed evaluation effects across four injected hard-exit boundaries.
assessments.note: Executed real process hard exits, stable evaluation IDs, exact final invariants, and durable contract/report digests give strong scoped causal evidence. Material limitation: no non-idempotent/non-reconcilable remote-provider negative control or independent replication.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not generalize to arbitrary remote providers, filesystems, network partitions, or exactly-once semantics outside the tested provider contract.

assessments.scoped_claim: On the precommitted scikit-learn Wine workload, direct-only, fixed-cap, static-percentile, and conditional-reforecast policies produced the same held-out aggregate outcome and zero switches, so no switching policy met the precommitted candidate rule in this easy/tight-deadline regime.
assessments.note: Precommit, disjoint calibration/evaluation seeds, exact aggregate metrics, and a completed real bundled dataset make the scoped null credible. The workload generated no usable switch opportunity, so it is not evidence for or against conditional switching in an actual overrun regime.
assessments.scope_guard: One dataset, two model families, one host/runtime; null result only for the exact precommitted regime.

assessments.scoped_claim: The Digits workload has a durable precommitted design suitable for a second independent overrun-regime attempt, but no final evaluation summary exists under the frozen evidence inspected here.
assessments.note: Useful bottleneck/precommit evidence only. Companion checkpoint records completed calibration and partial evaluation progress before timeout, with partial outcomes quarantined; there is no result to grade as a working optimizer intervention.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not infer candidate efficacy, threshold quality, or policy ordering from incomplete progress counters.

assessments.scoped_claim: A production incident demonstrates that an error-rate breaker can be structurally blind to a non-converging agent loop composed of individually successful tool calls.
assessments.note: The 54-consecutive-success incident is independently visible in the Agent Mesh primary abstract and directly supports the scoped structural failure claim. It does not estimate prevalence or validate the Phase-1 progress-breaker adaptation.
assessments.scope_guard: Single production platform and retrospective incident; Phase-1 trigger/signal/response mapping is an adaptation, not an original-source intervention result.

assessments.scoped_claim: A progress fingerprint constant by construction can deterministically misclassify a converging repair, and source-reported two-direction reversion checks separate the improving and genuinely stuck cases.
assessments.note: Strong mechanistic failure evidence within the studied platform; the abstract independently confirms the constant-fingerprint third-round false trip and 6/6-to-3/6 regression. The proposed generic discriminating-power gate remains a Phase-1 adaptation.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not claim the source filter is optimal outside the studied replay family.

assessments.scoped_claim: Transactional workspace cleanup can coexist with duplicated durable external effects across retries when the effect lies outside the containment boundary.
assessments.note: The Agent Mesh primary abstract independently confirms 21 events across six invocations; the worker preserves the important distinction that the general content-addressed effect ledger is proposed but not built.
assessments.scope_guard: Observed external-log incident and enumerated effect classes are platform-scoped; do not grade the unbuilt general ledger as effective.

assessments.scoped_claim: AWS Durable Execution documents that replay and retry can repeat side-effecting work; at-most-once is per retry attempt, and replay-stable idempotency identity is required for safe deduplication.
assessments.note: Independent vendor documentation verification strongly supports the execution-contract claim, but this is documented semantics rather than an empirical failure-frequency or intervention-effect study.
assessments.scope_guard: AWS Durable Execution semantics only; no general exactly-once claim.

assessments.scoped_claim: LangGraph continuation identity is thread-bound, paused interrupts require explicit reinvocation, and resumed nodes restart from the beginning, creating a documented replay boundary for pre-interrupt side effects.
assessments.note: Independent LangGraph documentation verification confirms the key semantics. The Phase-1 resume-identity and no-hidden-background acceptance rules are adaptations derived from those semantics, not source-tested parity interventions.
assessments.scope_guard: LangGraph runtime semantics only; not every agent framework.

assessments.scoped_claim: Broad scenario-membership routing can wake correct bystanders or omit the true state owner; source-reported observational routing changes reduced one case's blast radius from five components to two.
assessments.note: Useful quantitative primary failure evidence, independently consistent with the Agent Mesh abstract, but deployment before/after evidence is not randomized and the source explicitly says the motivating routing success criterion has not yet been observed live.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not treat first-unproven-transition routing or abstention as causally validated across workloads.

assessments.scoped_claim: The enforcement layer can itself produce false blocking or permissive judgments; the studied platform reports 12 such incidents, including one costing 107 turns with zero accepted writes.
assessments.note: The key incident counts are independently present in the primary abstract and strongly establish the scoped failure class. The response mechanisms are observational and their causal benefit remains unmeasured, so they are not promoted with the failure finding.
assessments.scope_guard: One strict platform; no population incidence or response-effect estimate.

assessments.scoped_claim: Checkpoint replay can recover execution position without guaranteeing identical generative behavior, motivating quarantine when identical state/environment/contract identity yields conflicting verification outcomes.
assessments.note: Credible platform diagnostic and deployed quarantine rule, but no independently extracted matched quantitative effect of quarantine on final task quality or false terminalization.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not generalize nondeterminism or quarantine efficacy to all replay systems.

assessments.scoped_claim: AgentRewind restores aligned agent context and controlled environment state, but the worker-extracted method boundary is local workspace restoration rather than a claim to undo arbitrary external side effects.
assessments.note: Primary AgentRewind identity/method and broad recovery results were independently verified. The exact external-effect boundary is retained at source-extraction scope; no independent replication of an external-effect failure was observed in this comparator run.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not infer failure inside AgentRewind's controlled workspace boundary or global rollback outside it.
